title: How to Export Devo Logs
content_md: Use the Devo Query API: send a LINQ query, a time range and an output mode to the /search/query endpoint of your region, authenticated with an API token or key and secret. Ask for a JSON mode and you get structured events; select the message field from raw tables to get the original lines back. The official Python SDK (devo-sdk) wraps the same API if you prefer code to curl. Devo stores large volumes of security and operational data in the cloud, often with long retention. Prime Core has 23,653 detection rules for Devo, mapped to 664 MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Below is how to get data out, sanitize it, and investigate it for free in LogTotal. Get Started For Free Before you start Credentials. Create an API token, or an API key and secret, in your Devo domain’s credentials settings, with access to the tables you need. Your region’s endpoint. The Query API host depends on where your domain lives, for example apiv2-us.devo.com or apiv2-eu.devo.com. Table names. Devo organizes data in tables like box.unix or firewall.fortinet.traffic. Find yours in the Data Search area, and build the query there first.
